title: BingshoCraft
body:
# 🎉 BingshoCraft is Finally Here!

After months of planning, building, testing, and polishing, we're excited to finally open the doors to **BingshoCraft**!
Our Survival server is now live, built to give you a long-term, fun, and balanced experience without taking away the vanilla feel.

### Here's what you can expect:
- 🌍 Custom generated terrain & structures
- 🛒 Fully custom economy shop
- ⚔️ Levelled mobs with better progression
- 🏡 Personal and Team Land claiming to protect your builds
- 👥 Team system to play with friends
- 🎖️ Ranks and progression
- 💀 Graves to keep your items safe
- ♾️ And many more to come...

Whether you're a casual builder, an explorer, or someone who loves grinding and progressing, there's something here for you. The server also supports **both Java and Bedrock Edition**, so you can play from almost any device.

**IP:** `play.bingsho.org` *(Default port)*

**Get whitelisted from:** https://discord.gg/bingsho

We can't wait to see the first towns, bases, shops, and communities you create.
Welcome to **BingshoCraft** ❤️
